summary: Engine-status test expects ClamAV to be unavailable on Windows too; the found-engine path is untested
evidence: lib.rs:91-96 asserts !status.available on every OS; lib.rs:35 is the is_file()==true branch with no test through current_virus_scanner
failure_scenario: On Windows with clamscan.exe next to the test binary, the test fails. Engine-present path has no automated check.
resolution_note: Owner sign-off 2026-11-18 (decision D7): ClamAV is not used; the engine is replaced per ADR 0004 (proposed). Finding concerns the clamscan/freshclam integration.
